messages:
Maya (CSM): FYI — Velox goes primetime next Tue 10:00am PST. We need a dedicated pool bring-up + bakeoff this week. Goal: quota to support ~300k tokens/min, autoscale 4->20 GPUs, 1h soak at ~75% peak. Dry-run Mon 9:00am PST. Owners?
Owen (Ops): Ack. Current reserved pool can do 16 GPUs steady, can request burst to 24. I'll open the quota ticket now. :+1:
Nina (Solutions Eng): I'll validate the customer's prompt set & golden evals. They want Llama2-70b q4_0 variant; confirm quant/profile and KMS.
Jamie (SRE): SRE checklist: canary 10% for first 15m, monitor p95 < 500ms, GPU util < 85%, queue depth < 20. I'll stand by during run.
deploy-bot: Pipeline queued: pipeline/velox-dedicated-bakeoff #457 — created by Maya.
Maya (CSM): Quick checklist: - Owen: create quota ticket (burst + reserve) - Nina: upload evals + blacklist bad prompts - Jamie: create dashboard & alerts - I'll run customer kickoff Mon 09:30. We need confirmations by EOD today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Owen (Ops): Quota ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/QTK-7891 — requesting burst to 24 GPUs, 16 reserved. CC @billing for cost approval.
Nina (Solutions Eng): Eval set uploaded to s3://velox/onboard/evals/primetime-v1.json. Found one prompt causing decoding loop, added to blacklist: prompts/looping-001. Also added expected latency baselines.
Jamie (SRE): Load generator config I'll run for bakeoff:
```
rload --target 900rps --concurrency 120 --duration 60m --token-dist zipf --models "llama2-70b-q4_0" --metrics gpu_util,latency,queue_depth
```
I'll also pin canary route: 10% -> dedicated, 90% -> hosted for first 15m then 100% shift if green. Alerting: pager if p95 > 700ms for 3m or queue_depth > 25.
Maya (CSM): Nina/Jamie — can you both confirm the KMS key + model variant by EOD? Customer needs the cert for compliance.
Nina (Solutions Eng): Confirmed KMS key is provisioned for Velox account (velox-kms-01) and model image llm/llama2-70b-q4_0:v2 is available.
Jamie (SRE): Dashboard created: /dashboards/velox-primetime-bakeoff. Shared with team. I'll post runbook snippet there.
Maya (CSM): Also: capture customer feedback & run notes after bakeoff. Nina, can you own the post-run summary?
Nina (Solutions Eng): Yep — will send a 1-pager and short survey link to Velox within 2 hours of finish. Will include failing prompts, perf deltas, and recommended autoscale tuning.
Owen (Ops): Scheduling note: dry-run Mon 09:00 -> 10:30 PST; official bakeoff Tue 09:30 -> 11:30 (prep for 10:00 launch). All set on my side.
Jamie (SRE): I'll be on-call during both windows and will keep an eye on tail latency and GPU throttling. If we hit sustained >85% GPU util, we fallback to model variant q4_1 (lower mem) and notify customer.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll DM the Velox contact the dry-run invite and attach the runbook. Posting final checklist in #customer-success after EOD. :rocket:
